violated_contract: A saved BLE pairing retains reconnect intent across a cold-start adapter or transport failure until the user disconnects, forgets, or a pairing-loss block requires recovery. Error cleanup must not masquerade as a manual disconnect and leave the process with no owner or retry path.
canonical_prevention: Retain one service/transport owner for pre-readiness failures; authorize native retry only from the saved pairing, ensure it on resume and adapter-on, and keep one capped backoff timer. Persist explicit user suppression before teardown, fence queued retries, and prove recovery and suppression through the real provider/service/native bridge path.
